script:
for d in /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0 /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/devfreq /sys/class/devfreq /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu2/cpufreq /sys/class/regulator; do echo "@@ DIRECTORY $d"; ls -l "$d" 2>&1; done
for f in /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpubusy /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpu_busy_percentage /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpuclk /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpu_available_frequencies /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/devfreq/cur_freq /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/devfreq/available_frequencies /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/devfreq/busy_time /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/devfreq/total_time /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/devfreq/trans_stat /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/devfreq/time_in_state /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/devfreq/voltage /sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/voltage /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/stats/time_in_state /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu2/cpufreq/stats/time_in_state /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/scaling_available_frequencies /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu2/cpufreq/scaling_available_frequencies /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/scaling_voltages /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/UV_mV_table /sys/kernel/debug/regulator/regulator_summary /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now /sys/class/power_supply/battery/status; do echo "@@ FILE $f"; cat "$f" 2>&1; echo "@@ RETURN $?"; done
getconf CLK_TCK 2>&1
meaning: read-only idle discovery; GPU counters read by this task only
